description: Store requester-selected data for a requester-selected period.

operation.description: Operation: store, retrieve, renew, or remove.

leaseId.description: Provider-generated 32-byte lease identifier; omitted for store.

sizeBytes.description: Exact number of bytes in store data.

retentionSeconds.description: Requested initial retention in whole seconds.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the complete stored byte sequence.

offset.description: Zero-based first byte offset for retrieval.

length.description: Number of bytes requested for retrieval.

expectedExpiresAt.description: Current lease expiration expected by a renewal requester.

operation.description: Completed operation: store, retrieve, renew, or remove.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the complete stored byte sequence.

acceptedAt.description: Provider lease-acceptance time in Unix seconds.

previousExpiresAt.description: Expiration time immediately before a successful renewal.

expiresAt.description: Current lease expiration time in Unix seconds.

offset.description: Zero-based offset of returned retrieval data.

price.description: Credits charged for the successful operation.

removed.description: True when the lease was ended successfully.

check.description: Challenge an active lease for the byte at one requester-selected offset and compare it locally with the original byte.

offset.description: Zero-based offset of the challenged byte.

outcome.description: Requester-computed result: pass, fail, or inconclusive.

value.description: One-byte provider evidence when evidence was returned.
